entries.title: Hebrews 6:1
segments: ¶Wherefore, leaving the word of the beginning of the Christ, let us go on [to what belongs] to full growth, not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works and faith in God,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:2
segments: of [the] doctrine of washings, and of imposition of hands, and of resurrection of [the] dead, and of eternal judgment;

entries.title: Hebrews 6:3
segments: and this will we do if God permit.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:4
segments: For it is impossible to renew again to repentance those once enlightened, and who have tasted of the heavenly gift, and have been made partakers of [the] Holy Spirit,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:5
segments: and have tasted the good word of God, and [the] works of power of [the] age to come,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:6
segments: and have fallen away, crucifying for themselves [as they do] the Son of God, and making a show of [him].

entries.title: Hebrews 6:7
segments: For ground which drinks the rain which comes often upon it, and produces useful herbs for those for whose sakes also it is tilled, partakes of blessing from God;

entries.title: Hebrews 6:8
segments: but bringing forth thorns and briars, it is found worthless and nigh to a curse, whose end [is] to be burned.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:9
segments: ¶But we are persuaded concerning you, beloved, better things, and connected with salvation, even if we speak thus.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:10
segments: For God [is] not unrighteous to forget your work, and the love which ye have shewn to his name, having ministered to the saints, and [still] ministering.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:11
segments: But we desire earnestly that each one of you shew the same diligence to the full assurance of hope unto the end;

entries.title: Hebrews 6:12
segments: that ye be not sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and patience have been inheritors of the promises.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:13
segments: For God, having promised to Abraham, since he had no greater to swear by, swore by himself,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:14
segments: saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee;

entries.title: Hebrews 6:15
segments: and thus, having had long patience, he got the promise.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:16
segments: For men indeed swear by a greater, and with them the oath is a term to all dispute, as making matters sure.

entries.title: Hebrews 6:17
segments: Wherein God, willing to shew more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the unchangeableness of his purpose, intervened by an oath,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:18
segments: that by two unchangeable things, in which [it was] impossible that God should lie, we might have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to lay hold on the hope set before us,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:19
segments: which we have as anchor of the soul, both secure and firm, and entering into that within the veil,

entries.title: Hebrews 6:20
segments: where Jesus is entered as forerunner for us, become for ever a high priest according to the order of Melchisedec.
